title: Core: Pen tool path closing and shape creation
description: Verify the pen tool state machine in packages/core/src/engine/pentool.ts. Specifically test: closePenPath creates a closed ShapePath, penStateToShapePath produces a valid ShapeDisplayObject, adding 3+ anchor points produces correct cubic bezier curves, smooth vs corner points produce different handle angles. Add 10+ tests in packages/core/src/engine/__tests__/pentool.test.ts if they don't already exist.
